notes:
Account background: Ochre Rail builds product analytics and in-app assistance for mid-market SaaS vendors. Evaluating Redwood as replacement for current LLM API provider (incumbent: OpenAI) — goal is Hosted -> Dedicated migration for cost predictability and data isolation.

Recent timeline (shorthand):
- 2026-02-25: POC kickoff (small dev cohort, ingest 12k docs). SE demo + API walkthrough.
- 2026-03-05: Hosted demo (ff_20260305_ochre-demo). Showed streaming + function-calls parity.
- 2026-03-09: Internal quality review: PM flagged regressions on summarization prompts (recall drop ~7%).
- 2026-03-11: Tech sync w/infra + security to discuss VPC Dedicated timeline.

Use-case / technical requirements (from CTO + PM):
- Primary workloads: document search (embeddings + reranking), support chat (multi-turn), personalized recommendations (embedding similarity).
- Latency targets: 95p latency for reranking < 120ms; chat token latency < 40ms p50; throughput target ~30 req/s for peak endpoints.
- Availability/SLA: required for prod Dedicated (99.9% min), audit logs + KMS integration mandatory.
- Model prefs: open to Redwood-curated Llama-family & Mistral variants; require ability to pin model versions and route to cheaper quantized variants for batch workloads.

POC details / findings:
- Integration approach: current stack uses OpenAI-compatible wrapper. Ochre implemented Redwood-hosted adapter; compatibility layer mostly works but saw tokenization differences leading to prompt-parity drift on a subset of prompts.
- Quality/regressions: PM: "We need parity or regressions below 5% for key prompts". Observed 5-9% quality delta on abstractive summarization and a small increase in hallucination rate for knowledge-grounded answers.
- Performance: Redwood hosted streaming + KV cache reduced average per-token latency vs incumbent in chat microbenchmarks; reranking latency currently 140ms p95 in Hosted POC (above target) — SE suspects batching config and kernel selection tuning for Dedicated will improve.
- Cost: Initial hosted cost per token slightly higher than incumbent; Redwood Optimize suggestions expected to lower unit cost at Dedicated scale (quantization + prefix cache).

Migration asks / product asks from Ochre:
- Native OpenAI-compat endpoint or adapter to reduce SDK changes.
- Clear guidance on prompt tokenization parity and reproducibility (tokenizer docs/tests).
- Regression alerts tied to prompt sets during rollout + evaluation harness.
- Dedicated capacity quote including burst policy, expected throughput, and cost breakouts (GPU type, concurrency).
- SSO/SAML onboarding checklist + SOC2/ISO artifacts for procurement.

Sales / commercial notes:
- Procurement sensitivity: legal team needs DPA + SOC2 report; procurement timeline ~6-8 weeks after final demo.
- Pricing posture: mid-market with cost sensitivity; willing to commit to 12-mo Dedicated if unit economics beat incumbent by >15% or if predictable committed capacity reduces ops effort.

- Redwood to provide Dedicated quote + expected uplift tuning plan by 2026-03-22.
